arms.predictors: separately trained factor predictors with their OWN encoder (5 out-of-fold over training configurations + 1 full-data) per seed

readouts: 2x2: flip / near-miss / invariance / pool accuracy, gap regret; shaping effect S1R0-S0R0, reading effect S0R1-S0R0, interaction; factor reliance (zero-factor action change) for R1 arms
consumers: same metrics with exact vs predicted inputs; exact->predicted degradation; reliance
entries.selection_rule: Reference = the better (screen pool eps-optimal accuracy) of S1R1 and S1R0 (strong ordinary equal-information baselines). Candidates = DEPLOYABLE arms/consumers (predicted-factor inputs only; exact-factor evaluations never selected). Choose the candidate with the largest mean screen flip-accuracy gain over the reference subject to: near-miss mean diff >= -.05, invariance mean diff >= -.03, pool accuracy >= reference - .02 and >= .70 absolute. If none qualifies (or best flip gain < .03) -> no confirmation of a repair; report branch E / negative and use remaining budget only for a localized follow-up.
entries.budget: ~12k core-s (bank mode); on-policy variants not run in screen
entries.addendum_1: Added before any P2 evaluation output exists (the screen is at the training stages): (a) SEP arm (--factor-mode sep): separately encoded predictor trained only by factor loss, policy reads its detached output (non-redundant READ), bank mode, seeds 40-44; (b) evalX: consumers evaluated with the HISTORICAL LRN-s(35+i) predictions replayed on the same history (P2 seed 40+i paired with LRN lineage 35+i), plus SEP-bank. SEP is a deployable candidate under the selection rule.
entries.addendum_2: Added after the independent P1 audit, before any P2 evaluation output: every factor-reading model (R1 arms, SEP, consumers, historical LRN/SUP references) is evaluated with factor channel phi in {own (its deployable input), exact, zero, population-mean (training-bank mean of exact targets)} on pool, flips, near-misses, invariances. Selection uses 'own' only; zero/mean separate decision-time reading from training-induced trunk/head effects. A candidate whose flip gain over the reference is not larger under 'own' than under 'zero'/'mean' is reported as a training-induced effect, not factor-mediated reading.
entries.result: b6c validation, seeds 40-44, two-level CIs in research/results/campaign-07/p2-screen/e07-p2-score. Reference = S1R1-bank (pool .819 > S1R0 .811): flip .469, near-miss .695, invariance .760. Deployable candidates @own flip: S0R1 .447, SEP .416, CONS-exact-pred .453, CONS-mix-pred .445, CONS-oof-pred .414, CONS-{exact,mix,oof}-predLRN .439/.444/.412 -> every flip gain vs reference < 0 (< .03 threshold) -> no confirmation of a repair (P2-CONFIRM not run as registered). Descriptive: 2x2 flip S0R0 .372 / S1R0 .453 / S0R1 .447 / S1R1 .469; near-miss .847 / .708 / .817 / .695; phi conditions barely move flips (S0R1 own .447 zero .441; S1R1 own .469 zero .475; CONS-exact exact .456 zero .445) but reading moves pool/invariance (CONS-exact exact vs zero: pool .826/.807, invariance .750/.685). All models lie near a flip/near-miss trade-off ((flip+near)/2 .55-.63); historical SUP flip .562 but near-miss .536. Preliminary reading: interventions shift action-change propensity, not interaction discrimination (analysis commissioned).
